name: poll-absent-invalid-word
description: CCR-11: until.absent accepts only "fail_open" or "pending" — any other word is KEEL-E001 at configure, in every implementation (and fails contracts/policy.schema.json, so check_schema.py sees it as invalid-as-designed). Modeled on scenario 47 (until.terminal item type), the sibling rule in the same paragraph of conformance/README.md's verdict section.
